# Bundled archive engine and codecs. No network access during configuration/build.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(ZLIB_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZLIB_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZLIB_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(zlib EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(bzip2 EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
foreach(option XZ_TOOL_XZ XZ_TOOL_XZDEC XZ_TOOL_LZMADEC XZ_TOOL_LZMAINFO XZ_TOOL_SCRIPTS XZ_DOC XZ_NLS)
  set(${option} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
add_subdirectory(xz EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
foreach(option ZSTD_BUILD_PROGRAMS ZSTD_BUILD_TESTS ZSTD_BUILD_SHARED ZSTD_BUILD_CONTRIB)
  set(${option} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(ZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(zstd/build/cmake EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(LZ4_BUILD_CLI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LZ4_BUILD_LEGACY_LZ4C OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LZ4_BUNDLED_MODE ON)
add_subdirectory(lz4/build/cmake EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
# Make the bundled targets visible to upstream libarchive's dependency discovery.
set(ZLIB_LIBRARY zlibstatic CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(ZLIB_LIBRARY_RELEASE zlibstatic CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(ZLIB_LIBRARY_DEBUG zlibstatic CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(BZIP2_LIBRARIES RetroMediaLab.Bzip2 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(BZIP2_LIBRARY_RELEASE RetroMediaLab.Bzip2 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(BZIP2_LIBRARY_DEBUG RetroMediaLab.Bzip2 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(BZIP2_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bzip2" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(LIBLZMA_LIBRARY liblzma CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LIBLZMA_LIBRARY_RELEASE liblzma CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LIBLZMA_LIBRARY_DEBUG liblzma CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LIBLZMA_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/xz/src/liblzma/api" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
foreach(flag LIBLZMA_HAS_AUTO_DECODER LIBLZMA_HAS_EASY_ENCODER LIBLZMA_HAS_LZMA_PRESET)
  set(${flag} TRUE CACHE INTERNAL "Bundled liblzma API" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(LZ4_LIBRARY lz4_static CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(LZ4_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lz4/lib" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(ZSTD_LIBRARY libzstd_static CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(ZSTD_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zstd/lib" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
foreach(flag HAVE_LIBZSTD HAVE_ZSTD_compressStream HAVE_ZSTD_minCLevel)
  set(${flag} TRUE CACHE INTERNAL "Bundled Zstandard API" FORCE)
endforeach()
# Calling convention is known for the static targets compiled in this build.
foreach(flag ZLIB_WINAPI ZLIB_DLL USE_BZIP2_DLL WITHOUT_LZMA_API_STATIC)
  set(${flag} FALSE CACHE INTERNAL "Bundled static codec" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(flag WITHOUT_ZLIB_DLL USE_BZIP2_STATIC LZMA_API_STATIC)
  set(${flag} TRUE CACHE INTERNAL "Bundled static codec" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(flag ZLIB_WINAPI ZLIB_DLL WITHOUT_ZLIB_DLL)
  set(${flag}_WITH_LIB zlibstatic CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(flag USE_BZIP2_DLL USE_BZIP2_STATIC)
  set(${flag}_WITH_LIB RetroMediaLab.Bzip2 CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(flag WITHOUT_LZMA_API_STATIC LZMA_API_STATIC)
  set(${flag}_WITH_LIB liblzma CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
foreach(option ENABLE_TEST ENABLE_INSTALL ENABLE_TAR ENABLE_CPIO ENABLE_CAT ENABLE_UNZIP ENABLE_WERROR ENABLE_OPENSSL ENABLE_MBEDTLS ENABLE_NETTLE ENABLE_LIBB2 ENABLE_LZO ENABLE_LIBXML2 ENABLE_EXPAT ENABLE_BSDXML ENABLE_PCREPOSIX ENABLE_PCRE2POSIX)
  set(${option} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endforeach()
set(HAVE_LZMA_STREAM_ENCODER_MT FALSE CACHE INTERNAL "libarchive uses portable single-threaded writer" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(libarchive EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
target_compile_definitions(archive_static INTERFACE LIBARCHIVE_STATIC)
add_library(RetroMediaLab.Archives INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(RetroMediaLab.Archives INTERFACE archive_static)
install(FILES libarchive/COPYING DESTINATION licenses/libarchive)
install(FILES zlib/LICENSE DESTINATION licenses/zlib)
install(FILES bzip2/LICENSE DESTINATION licenses/bzip2)
install(FILES xz/COPYING xz/COPYING.0BSD DESTINATION licenses/liblzma)
install(FILES zstd/LICENSE DESTINATION licenses/zstd)
install(FILES lz4/lib/LICENSE DESTINATION licenses/lz4)
